name: Prognoz-6
about: Prognoz-6 (1977-093A, IKI/BABTS), launched 1977 Sep 22. Its phases from GCAT: 168.1E 37.1S. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
